body: Read performed. Source: TASK.md. Locator: workspace root, sha256 6dafd85c20e29a855ea291785bf331200df032c33e17ac2ed5ed731452c79e0c, 3061 bytes, 7 lines, read in full via bounded read_file (whole file and lines 1-7). Version: the only version present; no version history observable. Role: procedural task instructions (delivery structure, versioning, binding rules), not substantive research subject matter. Finding links: governs the form of R001 through R012 and of every artifact in this acquisition; no scientific finding is sourced from it. Lines of evidence cited elsewhere: lines 1, 3, 5 (delivery, observation and binding rules).

Read performed. Source: inputs/brief.md, Slide Scout product brief. Locator: sha256 f4f88faef06f7cc95c6935e2e43afe562bbdfc29ee85d984f8c59f0232c8556a, 905 bytes, 5 lines, read in full via bounded read_file; additionally verified via mechanical cache_source (byte copy at out/probe/brief-cache.md, same sha256) and mechanical line_map (out/probe/brief-line-map.md, per-line text used for line-precise citations). Version: the only version present. Role: the entire substantive admitted corpus for this goal. Finding links: R001 (lines 3, 5), R002 (line 3), R003 (line 3), R004 (line 3), R005 (line 3), R006 (line 3), R007 (line 3), R008 (line 3), R009 (line 5), R010 (line 5), R011 (line 5), R012 (whole file).

Read NOT performed; assignment artifact unavailable. Probes for an assignment file all failed: inputs/assignment.md, inputs/assignment.json, inputs/assignment.txt, inputs/assignment-v1.md and the directory path inputs/assignment returned FileNotFoundError. The workspace root also contains an entry named assignment.md, which every bounded tool call refused (read_file whole and with line ranges; mechanical line_map, cache_source, render_sections all returned ValueError). Precision note: in this environment ValueError is returned both for directory paths (reading the inputs directory itself is refused with ValueError although inputs is inside the working set) and for paths the tools refuse on other grounds, and child paths under the root entry return ValueError rather than the NotADirectoryError that a plain unreadable file produces; the entry's exact nature (directory, symlink, or otherwise blocked) therefore remains unresolved. The established facts are only that the entry exists and that no admitted tool can read it, so no content of it is known or claimed. Per task rules this failed read is not evidence that no assignment exists anywhere; it is recorded as an undeveloped lead: a root entry named assignment.md whose examination would require tooling beyond the bounded set granted for this goal.

Read NOT performed; thin plan artifact unavailable. The directory path inputs/plan exists (direct reads and mechanical operations on the directory path itself return ValueError consistent with a directory, while the directory is inside the allowed boundary). The bounded tools provide no directory listing, so contents were probed by name; every candidate returned FileNotFoundError: thin-plan.md, README.md, README, plan.md, thin.md, thin_plan.md, current.md, initial-plan.md, research-plan.md, thin-plan-v1.md, scout-plan.md, plan-v001.md, plan-001.md, v001.md, V001.md, v1, T03.md, assignment.md, thin. Nineteen named probes in total; none succeeded. No claim is made that the directory is empty or that no plan exists; the finding is limited to: no readable plan file was locatable under the names probed with the tools admitted for this goal. Undeveloped leads: the plan may exist under a name outside the probed set or in an out-of-boundary location such as the root entry plan.md, which refuses all reads identically to the root entry assignment.md.

Read NOT performed; source corpus unavailable beyond the brief. The directory path inputs/sources exists (same probe signature as inputs/plan: ValueError on the directory path itself, inside the allowed boundary). Every named candidate returned FileNotFoundError: index.md, index.json, README.md, README, manifest.json, corpus.md, corpus.txt, corpus-001.md, sources.json, all-sources.md, overview.md, spec.md, spec, readers.md, ome-zarr.md, ome-zarr-0.5.md, ome-zarr-py.md, ome-zarr-spec.md, ome-zarr-0.5-spec.md, ome-ngff.md, ngff.md, ngff-0.5.md, ngio.md, ngio-docs.md, zarr.md, zarr-python.md, vizarr.md, S001, S001.md, s001, s001.md, s01.md, 001, 001.md, 01.md, 1.md, source-001.md, v1, V001.md, docs, .index, .manifest. Forty-two named probes in total; none succeeded. Per task rules this is not evidence of corpus-wide absence and no such claim is made; the honest statement is that no corpus member was locatable or readable with the admitted tools. Undeveloped leads: corpus files under unprobed names, non-markdown extensions not probed, deeper nesting not probed, and out-of-boundary locations.

Coverage limits for the entire acquisition. First, the only reads that succeeded in this goal were TASK.md and paths under inputs/ and out/; the workspace-root entries assignment.md and plan.md were refused on every attempt with ValueError, an error this environment also produces for directory paths, so those entries could not be characterized at all beyond their existence (see A003). Second, the bounded tools provide no directory listing, so locating inputs/plan and inputs/sources content relied on name probing (sixty-one distinct names across both directories, all unsuccessful) and absence of a hit must not be read as absence of content. Third, live fetching is prohibited for this goal, so no external specification or reader documentation could be consulted; all statements about OME-Zarr 0.5, ecosystem readers, and Zarr internals that appear in R002 through R011 are model knowledge or inference, explicitly labeled there, and remain unverified by any corpus source. Fourth, no unperformed read or test is claimed anywhere: the derived artifacts out/probe/brief-cache.md and out/probe/brief-line-map.md were produced from inputs/brief.md only, and six mechanical operations against refused or directory paths (sources-map.txt, plan-map.txt, assignment-cache.bin, sources-cache.bin, assignment-sections.md, inputs-sections.md under out/probe/) failed and produced no output. Proposed remediation (UNEXECUTED, requires host action beyond the bounded tools): admit the assignment, thin plan, and corpus into inputs/, after which A003 through A005 must be re-run and every R finding reconciled.
